translations.web: I have compared you, my love, to a steed in Pharaoh’s chariots.
translations.bsb: I compare you, my darling, to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots.
translations.kjv: I have compared thee, O my love, to a company of horses in Pharaoh's chariots.
